verdict.rationale: Rootly's own escalation-policy docs describe notifying responders when an alert is not acknowledged in time, with multi-step targets and time delays, which covers the core multi-step, delayed escalation. 'Round robin' distributes pages among responders and is not the same as repeating the whole policy, so repeat rounds are unevidenced and coverage is partial. Missing for 10: documented repeat rounds (re-running the policy until acknowledgment), explicit fallback-responder detail beyond 'multi-step targets', independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, escalation policies walk unacknowledged pages through multiple steps — delays, fallback responders, and repeat rounds — until someone acknowledges

citations.quote: Configure Rootly escalation policies with multi-step targets, time delays, and round robin to make sure on-call alerts get acknowledged and acted on.
Escalation Policies define **how Rootly notifies responders when an alert requires attention** and what happens if that alert is not acknowledged in time.
